subject.title: refactor(pairing): store channel pairing state in SQLite

question: Does the fresh-install and upgrade evidence sufficiently prove that pairing authorization survives migration while ambiguous legacy files fail closed with an actionable recovery path?
rationale: Unit and migration tests are strong, but this change moves access-control state and intentionally stops runtime fallback reads, so maintainers must accept the observed upgrade behavior rather than infer it from mocks.

options.title: Require live upgrade proof
options.body: Request a redacted terminal or runtime transcript showing pairing, approval, restart, recognized legacy import, source removal, and the ambiguous-file warning before merge.

options.title: Accept test-only evidence
options.body: Merge based on the focused Testbox coverage while explicitly accepting that real upgrade and operator-recovery behavior was not observed.

recommendation.title: Require live upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Request a redacted terminal or runtime transcript showing pairing, approval, restart, recognized legacy import, source removal, and the ambiguous-file warning before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the proposed pairing migration and are the best available person to supply or evaluate the missing real upgrade evidence.
